newsitem.title: UK: LME copper edges slightly higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper edges slightly higher in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices continued their modest recovery from the lows hit earlier on Monday during the eveing session, adding about $3-$4 to late kerb levels.
By 1800 GMT three months copper was indicated at $1,886/$1,889 versus a kerb close of $1,883, down $17 from Friday, and an intraday low of $1,864.
Traders said copper's short-term downside objective is $1,850 if $1,900 cannot be regained. Stocks are seen falling tomorrow but this may not dispel current negative sentiment.

Nickel eased slightly in post-kerb business ahead of a forecast increase in warehouse stocks on Tuesday morning but held above the day's low of $7,200. It was at $7,270/$7,300 down around $45/$25 from the kerb.
The other metals were mainly unchanged from the kerb.
